pages.text: Mobzilla falls carrying enough meat to feed a settlement — this is what a settlement does with it. The $(item)Mobzilla Feast$() is victory, plated.

pages.title: Spoils of War
pages.text: One feast marks the occasion; the leftover mountain of meat keeps the jerky rack and burger press running for weeks.$(p)Serve it at the table like any feast block — four servings, carved by hand, best enjoyed while the scales are still warm.
